title: Triage Map Visuals + Annotated Troubleshoot Screenshots for Error States
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: Produce a compact, scannable set of UX assets and annotated product screenshots that help users quickly diagnose and act on common runtime error states (rate limits, timeouts, transient failures, and retry behavior). Deliverables are optimized for the quickstart docs, onboarding checklist, and the Console release notes.
deliverables: Triage Map (1x SVG, 3 responsive sizes): a single-page visual that routes a user from observed symptom -> likely cause -> immediate action -> longer-term mitigation. Includes separate lanes for Hosted / Dedicated / Private implications.
Diagnostic Card Set (3 PNG/SVG variants): Rate Limit card, Timeout card, Transient/5xx card. Each card includes 'What it means', 'First step', 'If it persists', and 'Console path' microcopy.
Retry Strategy Sequence (animated GIF & static frames): illustrates exponential backoff with jitter, recommended client sleep/timeouts, and server-side circuit-breaker signals.

Console Annotated Screenshots (desktop + mobile): annotated screenshots showing where to find per-request IDs, latency/tokens breakdown, retriable flag, and how to open the request trace. Includes hover-state microcopy for the error pill and the suggested 'Retry' quick action.
KV-cache hint overlay and preferred placement (SVG): a small inline visual that can be used in docs to explain when prefix/KV caching will reduce the cost of retries and rate-limited flows.
Accessibility checklist and localization-ready copy deck: contrast-safe palette, alt text for each image, and a single source string file for i18n handoff.
Figma file with components + export-ready slices and a README with usage guidance for engineering/docs teams.
acceptance_criteria: Assets exported in SVG/PNG/GIF and available in Figma; three responsive sizes for web/docs (desktop, tablet, mobile)
Microcopy passed by PM and Localization for English baseline and flagged for translation readiness
Design tokens and palette include AA contrast-compliant versions; accessibility checklist validated by Accessibility SME
Console screenshots approved by Eng (feature flags visible), and annotations reference concrete console elements (route name, request id, token breakdown)
Handoff ticket to docs repo with example markdown showing inline placement and recommended alt text
